versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the job-fit-proposal-writer skill.
- Automatically reviews group job listings against Caleb's real profile.
- Instantly skips jobs outside profile focus with a single-line explanation.
- For in-scope jobs, provides a direct fit assessment, budget and client check, and a concise, ready-to-send proposal.
- Answers job-specific screening questions and includes practical tips on how to win each job.
- Ensures only real qualifications and experience are cited, for honest and efficient job match decisions.
